name: IMPOSSIBLE Ranks Obby
desc:
Enjoy 200+ challenging stages! Levels start easy but get much harder. This game is a true test of skill, only the best will make it to the end! 🏆

Climb the ranks as you progress: 🥉 Bronze → 💎 Diamond → 👑 Master → ⭐ Legend & more! Can you reach the top? 🔥

Current Ranks:
1) 🥉 Bronze
2) 🥈 Silver
3) 🥇 Gold
4) 🌌 Platinum
5) 💎 Diamond
6) 🏆 Champion
7) ❤️ Ruby
8) 👑 Master
9) 🌟 Legend
10)🖤 Dark Matter
11)🌥️ Heaven
12)✨ Infinity
13) ❓ Secret

CONTROLS (Computer, Console):
- Reset Character (R, Y)
- Shift Lock (Shift, LT)
